title: Smart Data Models - HSDS - Service
description: The details of the services provided by organizations to a range of different groups. (Human Services Data Specification 3.3.1, object 'service': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json. Field names are kept verbatim (snake_case) except 'id' -> 'hsdsId'.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity (NGSI-LD): urn:ngsi-ld:Service:<HSDS id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Service'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hsdsId.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/id'. The identifier for the service. Each service must have a unique identifier. HSDS field 'id', renamed because 'id' is reserved in NGSI-LD.

organization_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/organization_id'. The identifier of the organization that provides this service. In HSDS this is an HSDS identifier (uuid); here it holds the URN of the Organization entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Organization:<HSDS id>).

program_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/program_id'. The identifier of the program this service is delivered under. In HSDS this is an HSDS identifier (uuid); here it holds the URN of the Program entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Program:<HSDS id>).

name.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/name'. The official or public name of the service.

alternate_name.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/alternate_name'. An (optional) alternative name for this service.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/description'. A free text description of the service.

additional_urls.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/additional_urls'. The details of additional URLs for the service

email.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/email'. An email address which can be used to contact the service provider.

status.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/status'. The current status of the service which can be active, inactive, defunct, or temporarily closed.

interpretation_services.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/interpretation_services'. A free text description of any interpretation services available for accessing this service.

application_process.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/application_process'. A free text description of the steps needed to access this service.

fees_description.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/fees_description'. A free text description of any charges for service users to access this service.

accreditations.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/accreditations'. A free text description of any accreditations. Accreditation is the formal evaluation of an organization or program against best practice standards set by an accrediting organization.

eligibility_description.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/eligibility_description'. A free text description of the type of person for whom this service is intended.

minimum_age.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/minimum_age'. The minimum age of a person required to meet this eligibility requirement. Units:'years'.

maximum_age.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/maximum_age'. The maximum age of a person required to meet this eligibility requirement. Units:'years'.

assured_date.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/assured_date'. The date that the information about the service was last checked. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

assurer_email.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/assurer_email'. The contact e-mail address for the person or organization which last assured the service.

alert.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/alert'. A description of any short term alerts concerning the service.

last_modified.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/last_modified'. The datetime when the service, or any related information about the service, has changed. Should have millisecond accuracy. (HSDS tabular type: datetime.)

phones.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/phones'. The details of the telephone numbers used to contact organizations, services, and locations.

operating_hours.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/operating_hours'. An array of `Schedule` objects which detail when a service operates

events.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/events'. An array of `Schedule` objects which give details of events associated with the Service. These may or may not be aligned with the Service's regular operating hours.

service_areas.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/service_areas'. The details of the geographic area for which a service is available.

service_at_locations.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/service_at_locations'. A link between a service and a specific location. In HSDS this is embedded HSDS objects; here it holds the URN of the ServiceAtLocation entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceAtLocation:<HSDS id>).

languages.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/languages'. The details of the languages that are spoken at locations or services. This does not include languages which can only be used with interpretation.

funding.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/funding'. The sources of funding for a service or organization.

cost_options.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/cost_options'. The costs of a service at certain points in time. This is an LGA Extension table. This table provides a structured version of the text information contained in the 'fees' field of the 'service' table.

required_documents.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/required_documents'. The details of any documents that are required in order to access or use services.

contacts.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/contacts'. The details of the named contacts for services and organizations.

capacities.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/capacities'. The details of capacities of this service. See `service_capacity`.

attributes.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/attributes'. A link between a service and one or more classifications that describe the nature of the service provided.

metadata.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/service.json#/properties/metadata'. A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information.

last_action_type.title: Last Action Type

field_name.title: Field Name

previous_value.title: Previous Value

replacement_value.title: Replacement Value
replacement_value.description: The new value of the field that has been modified.

updated_by.title: Updated By

location_id.title: Location Identifier

service_id.title: Service Identifier
service_id.description: The identifier of the service for which this is the phone number.

organization_id.title: Organization Identifier
organization_id.description: The identifier of the organization for which this is the phone number.

contact_id.title: Contact Identifier
contact_id.description: The identifier of the contact for which this is the phone number.

service_at_location_id.title: Service At Location Identifier
service_at_location_id.description: The identifier of the ‘service at location’ table entry, when this phone number is specific to a service in a particular location.

extension.title: Extension
extension.description: The extension of the phone number.

type.title: Type
type.description: Indicates the type of phone service, drawing from the RFC6350 list of types (text (for SMS), voice, fax, cell, video, pager, textphone).

description.title: Description
description.description: A free text description providing extra information about the phone service

languages.title: Languages

schedule.title: schedule
schedule.description: The details of when a service or location is open. Entries are RFC 5545 RRULES. (HSDS object 'schedule': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/schedule.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier for the schedule. Each entry must have a unique identifier.

service_id.title: Service Identifier
service_id.description: The identifier of the service for which this is the regular schedule

location_id.title: Location Identifier
location_id.description: The identifier of the location for which this is the regular schedule

service_at_location_id.title: Service At Location Identifier
service_at_location_id.description: The identifier of the ‘service at location’ table entry, when this schedule is specific to a service in a particular location.

valid_from.title: Valid From
valid_from.description: The date from which the schedule information is valid. It must be in the ISO 8601 format of YYYY-MM-DD, (HSDS tabular type: date.)

valid_to.title: Valid To
valid_to.description: The last date on which the schedule information is valid. It must be in the ISO 8601 format of YYYY-MM-DD. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

dtstart.title: Date Start
dtstart.description: iCal - The date of the first event is the schedule. Necessary when using the ‘interval’ feature, optional otherwise. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The timezone that all dates are expressed as, expressed as a UTC offset. Dates are assumed to be UTC otherwise.

until.title: Until
until.description: iCal - The date of the last occurrence of the recurring event. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

count.title: Count
count.description: iCal - The number of times that the event occurs. Use this instead of ‘until’, if appropriate.

wkst.title: Week Start
wkst.description: iCal - The two-letter code for the day on which the week starts: `MO`, `TU`, `WE`, `TH`, `FR`, `FR`, `SA`, `SU`

freq.title: Frequency
freq.description: iCal - How often the frequency repeats. Values can be `WEEKLY` or `MONTHLY`

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: iCal - How often the frequency repeats. For example, and Interval of 2 for a WEEKLY Frequency would represent fortnightly.

byday.title: By Day
byday.description: iCal - Comma separated days of the week. Where freq is MONTHLY each part can be preceded by a positive or negative integer to represent which occurrence in a month; e.g. 2MO is the second Monday in a month. -1FR is the last Friday

byweekno.title: By Week Number
byweekno.description: iCal - Comma separated numeric weeks of the year, where freq is WEEKLY. Can be negative to represent weeks before the end of the year; e.g. -5 is the 5th to last week in a year.

bymonthday.title: By Month Day
bymonthday.description: iCal - Comma separated numeric days of the month, where frequency is MONTHLY. Can be negative to represent days before the end of the month; e.g. -5 is the 5th to last day in a month.

byyearday.title: By Year Day
byyearday.description: iCal - Comma separated numeric days of the month, where frequency is YEARLY. Can be negative to represent days before the end of the year; e.g. -1 is the last day in a year.

description.title: Description
description.description: A free text description of the availability of the service.

opens_at.title: Opens At
opens_at.description: The time when a service or location opens. This should use HH:MM format and should include timezone information, either adding the suffix ‘Z’ when the date is in UTC, or including an offset from UTC (e.g. 09:00-05:00 for 9am EST.) (HSDS tabular type: time.)

closes_at.title: Closes At
closes_at.description: The time when a service or location closes. This should use HH:MM format and should include timezone information, either adding the suffix ‘Z’ when the date is in UTC, or including an offset from UTC (e.g. 09:00-05:00 for 9am EST.). (HSDS tabular type: time.)

schedule_link.title: Schedule Link
schedule_link.description: URL of a link for the schedule which may show each individual session and may provide a booking facility.

attending_type.title: Attending Type
attending_type.description: A free text description of how to attend this service.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free text notes on the schedule.

group.title: Group
group.description: A string label acting as a group identifier, allowing different schedules to be grouped together. For example, two schedules with the group `regular-hours` would be grouped separately from two schedules with the label `holiday-schedule`. The value of this field does not need to be readable or meaningful to humans, but it is recommended to make it so.

parent_id.description: If this is a child term in a hierarchical taxonomy, give the identifier of the parent category. For top-level categories, this is not required.

taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.description: If this is an established taxonomy, a free text description of which taxonomy is in use. If possible, provide a URI.

taxonomy_detail.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy_detail.description: Taxonomies from which taxonomy terms are taken

language.title: Language
language.description: An ISO 639-1, ISO 639-2, or ISO 639-3 [language code](http://www.loc.gov/standards/iso639-2/php/code_list.php) to represent the language of the term. The three-letter codes from ISO 639-2 and ISO 639-3 provide greater accuracy when describing variants of languages, which may be relevant to particular communities.

unit.title: unit
unit.description: The details of units which are used to measure service capacity. (HSDS object 'unit': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/unit.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier for the unit object. Each unit must have a unique identifier.

name.title: Name
name.description: The human-readable name for this unit e.g. “Bed” or “Hours”

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The scheme which formalizes the unit, if applicable e.g. “SI” for Standard International Units such as Kilogram, Litre, etc.

identifier.title: Unit Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier of the unit taken from the scheme if applicable e.g. `kgm` for Kilogram.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: The URI to the definition of the unit, if applicable

label.title: Label
label.description: The human-readable label for this url e.g. “Twitter” or “Website”.

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL for this URL object. This must be formatted as a valid URI.

organization_id.title: Organization Identifier
organization_id.description: The identifier for the organization associated with this URL object
